request.grammar:
root ::= "{" ws "\"unsupported_probability\"" ws ":" ws probability ws "," ws "\"source_sentence_id\"" ws ":" ws citation ws "}"
probability ::= "0" ("." [0-9]+)? | "1" ("." "0"+)?
citation ::= "null" | "0" | [1-9] [0-9]*
ws ::= [ \t\n\r]*

Return only a JSON object with unsupported_probability and source_sentence_id. Use null when no visible source sentence is a proposed witness.
